description: Janglim is an embeddable LALR parser-generator engine for .NET with C# and EBNF grammars, longest-match lexing, parser-driven token sources, and registered C# predicates. Includes ECMAScript 2026 Script, Module and expression parsing with strict/non-strict validation and optional browser compatibility, plus initial TypeScript type, declaration, assertion and class syntax support. Inspect parsing tables, FIRST/FOLLOW sets, traces, syntax trees and diagnostics, with incremental reparsing and pluggable error recovery.
releaseNotes: Janglim 0.6.0 unifies JavaScript APIs as JavaScriptGrammar and adds non-strict mode, optional Annex B compatibility and reproducible ECMAScript syntax audits. Adds initial TypeScript types, declarations, as/satisfies/non-null assertions and class extensions. Fixes late LALR lookahead propagation, returns epsilon for FIRST of an empty sequence, and rejects nonproductive grammars. Migration: use JavaScriptGrammar with inputKind; CanonicalRelation.LookAheadTable values are now LookAheadEntry, with the token set in .LookAhead. Check Parsing and Validate together. TypeScript support is partial and does not perform type checking. Full release notes: https://github.com/AJ-comp/Compiler/blob/master/RELEASE_NOTES.md
